description: Core trip scaffold. Sections gated by `when`: always | group | international | multi_base | driving. t_minus = days before departure the task is due.

tasks.desc: Roster locked — hard commit from every traveler
Everyone's dates / budget / departure airport collected (privately)
Money-split method agreed and set up; kitty rules defined
Booking deadline announced — commit with money by this date
Roles assigned: trip lead, bookings owner, money tracker
Who has booked what — tracked
Cost-split ledger current
Date window confirmed with all travelers
Seasonality / local-holiday check on candidate windows
Exact dates locked
Time off booked and approved — before flights are bought
Visa requirement per traveler nationality — official source only
Passport validity rule for destination (6-month / 3-month / blank pages)
Health: recommended vaccines & risks for this route (travel clinic guidance)
Payment culture: cash vs card, ATM strategy, tipping norms
Scarcity list: attractions/experiences that sell out — with booking windows
Seasonal traps: closures, festivals, weather risks in the travel window
Entry/exit extras: onward-ticket proof, arrival cards, customs limits
Every passport checked against destination validity rule
Passport renewals started where needed
Visas applied for (official portal)
Visas approved & verified character-for-character against passports
Copies: passports + visas printed and saved offline for everyone
Search run (kiwi + skiplagged; award search if points in play)
Option chosen — route, airline, cash vs points, per-person price
Fare watch cron set on chosen route
Booked — names verified against passports, confirmations saved
Seats picked / bags added per airline limits
Online check-in
Area / neighborhood chosen per base
Search run (trivago; vrbo / premium-hotels for groups or luxe)
Booked — capacity & cancellation verified, confirmations saved
First-night arrival details confirmed (check-in time, address saved offline)
Shortlist researched and group-ranked
Must-books from the scarcity list booked
Day-by-day itinerary drafted (leave whitespace)
Group-size dinner reservations for locked-in nights
Legs between bases chosen (flight / train / ferry / van)
Intercity legs booked
Luggage logistics between bases sorted
License/permit rules checked (IDP where required)
IDPs obtained for all drivers
Rental booked — insurance coverage verified, driving traps researched (tolls, restricted zones)
Airport ↔ lodging plan, both ends (pre-book group-size transfer)
Local transit approach decided (apps installed, passes researched)
Travel clinic visits done per research recs
Prescriptions: full-trip supply, original packaging, legality checked
First-aid / repellent / sunscreen kit built
Allergies, blood types, emergency contacts in shared doc
Travel medical + evacuation coverage bought (activity exclusions checked)
Card trip-protection reviewed to avoid double-buying
Policy numbers + claims hotline saved offline by everyone
Budget per person set: flights / lodging / daily / excursions
No-FX-fee cards and ATM strategy sorted per research
Arrival cash plan set
Travel notices set; card-freeze numbers saved
Data sorted: eSIM/roaming bought and installed
Destination apps installed: transport, translate + offline pack, offline maps, split-costs
On-trip group chat created; numbers exchanged
Packing list published — season, dress codes, power adapters, baggage limits
Weather-checked final adjustments
Sitters / mail / plants arranged
Work OOO + handoffs set; mid-trip bills paid
Home-side airport transfer or parking booked
Itinerary + document copies with an emergency contact
All flights reconfirmed; schedule changes checked
Documents loaded offline on every phone
Everything charged; entertainment downloaded
Group check-in: passport / visa / cards / meds — from everyone
